targetWords.context: One proposal promised to slash every environmental problem at once, but the town rejected that exaggeration.

paragraphs.en: A coastal town wanted to become a haven for visitors without destroying the ecosystem that made it attractive. A new grid connected the port to clean electricity, while volunteers used an old jack to repair observation platforms. They removed debris that could mar the shoreline and learned to navigate around nesting areas. One proposal promised to slash every environmental problem at once, but the town rejected that exaggeration. Even a trillion units of investment would be wasted if basic care were absent.
paragraphs.zh: 一个海滨小镇希望成为游客向往的安静去处，同时保护让它具有吸引力的生态系统。新电网为港口提供清洁电力，志愿者用旧千斤顶维修观测平台。他们清除可能破坏海岸的碎片，并学会绕开筑巢区域通行。有提案声称能一举大幅减少所有环境问题，但小镇拒绝了这种夸张说法。即使投入万亿资金，缺乏基本维护也会造成浪费。

paragraphs.en: The health centre joined the project because conservation and public hygiene were closely connected. Its pharmacy explained why an antibiotic should not be treated as an ordinary capsule of comfort. A rash might be contagious, while a bruise usually was not; a benign condition differed greatly from a malignant one. Residents also learned about calcium, metabolism, and the proper use of medication. A diagram distinguished a vein from an artery and identified the appendix. The aim was understanding, not teaching neighbours to diagnose one another.

paragraphs.en: A specialist in psychiatry noted that fear of illness could make every mortal feel unusually helpless. The centre therefore created a supportive mindset rather than a competition over longevity. A hardy person still needed rest, and a conducive environment included social contact as well as clean water. Local hockey players helped deliver meals, while a referee organised a discussion of fairness. Volunteers agreed on simple etiquette and asked an editor to proofread notices so that technical language would not exclude residents.

paragraphs.en: The visitor centre served an olive salad rather than advertising a casino or an expensive cocktail bar. Its mural depicted a knight protecting a river, but the guide explained that modern protection required collective intellect rather than a lone hero. The project succeeded because health, livelihoods, and nature were considered together. A coast cannot flourish when its residents are pushed aside, just as a community cannot thrive when the living systems around it are treated as disposable scenery.
